messages.content: Each word in your response must start with the next letter of the alphabet, looping back to 'A' after 'Z'. Transform the poetic stanza into a description for an anime.  We are the school idols, hearts on fire, Singing our stories, reaching higher. Together we shine, a symphony, In this dance of youth and melody.

message.content: Anime series about high school girls forming a band to become famous musicians. They perform live concerts with passion. Their voices carry hope. The show features vibrant animation. It captures the joy of teamwork. Viewers enjoy catchy songs. The story follows their growth. Each episode highlights new challenges. The music is central to the plot. Fans love the emotional depth. The ending leaves a lasting impression.
